title: SOMA
description: SOMA is a living sound instrument for rooms, practice and composition.
subtitle: A living sound instrument for rooms, practice and composition.
imageAlt: The SOMA living sound instrument interface.
question: WHAT IF SOUND COULD REMAIN A PLACE, RATHER THAN COLLAPSE INTO CONTENT?
bodyOne: SOMA begins with a shift in status. Recorded matter is not treated as a finished track but as a field: something that can remain live, be shaped, revisited and held.
bodyTwo: The complete desktop instrument runs locally, without an account or cloud dependency. Its engine stays with the player; its state can be operated rather than consumed.
modes: Meet the field through listening and movement.
Compose a state through the instrument’s working surface.
Prepare a room and guide a shared listening practice.
enables: Preserve the conditions of a listening state.
Move between private practice, creation and facilitation.
destinationCopy: The MARS chapter establishes the question. The complete IFAH site contains the public experience, First Circle and acquisition path.

title: ARCHÉ
description: ARCHÉ is a playable way of reading Paris through movement, presence and symbols.
subtitle: A city read through movement, attention and authored rules.
imageAlt: ARCHÉ, a playable map and memory of Paris.
question: WHAT IF A MAP REMEMBERED YOUR PRESENCE INSTEAD OF TELLING YOU WHERE TO GO?
bodyOne: ARCHÉ turns Paris into an authored field. Symbols, riddles, meridians and physical traces ask the visitor to change focus: the city is not background but material.
bodyTwo: Progress is earned by being there. Signal strengthens through proximity; discoveries become traces; explored arrondissements become a personal constellation.
fieldTitle: THE QUEST UNFOLDS IN THE WALK, NOT ON THE SCREEN.
modes: Manifesto, gesture and the foundation of the city-instrument.
Authored passages, hidden symbols and evidence found on site.
Axis, proximity, signal and recognition translated into a field.
enablesTitle: A MAP OF MEMORY, NOT NAVIGATION.
enables: Collect symbols that habit normally hides.
Turn proximity and movement into legible signal.
Leave with a constellation of places actually crossed.
destinationCopy: Open the live ARCHÉ experience to see the map, walks, symbols and instruments in their native world.

title: RAMIFICATION
description: Ramification follows weak public signals until operational structure becomes visible.
subtitle: A system for following weak signals until operational structure becomes visible.
question: WHAT BECOMES VISIBLE WHEN A WEAK SIGNAL IS FOLLOWED WITHOUT PRETENDING IT IS A PREDICTION?
bodyOne: Ramification reconstructs hidden structure from public record: binding constraints, dependency chains and the seams where apparently compatible facts stop reconciling.
bodyTwo: The output is a case, not an oracle. Evidence, uncertainty and the route through the material remain visible while the engine stays behind the artifact.
fieldTitle: FROM PUBLIC TRACE TO OPERATIONAL STRUCTURE.
modes: Locate a public trace that does not yet explain itself.
Identify what the system cannot avoid or freely change.
Expose the dependencies, seams and unresolved facts.
enablesTitle: A DECISION SURFACE WITH ITS LIMITS INTACT.
enables: See which constraints actually bind the system.
Separate evidence from inference and uncertainty.
Build a case another person can inspect and challenge.
destinationCopy: Ramification currently begins by enquiry. Describe the system, public signal or unresolved contradiction.

title: SWEET DREAMS
description: Sweet Dreams — feature film, original score, 2023.
subtitle: Feature film · original score.
question: HOW CAN A SCORE HOLD THE CLIMATE OF A FILM WITHOUT EXPLAINING IT?
bodyOne: The score belongs to the perception laboratory that preceded MARS: composition understood as a way of shaping attention, duration and emotional space.
bodyTwo: This archive entry records the work without turning it into a campaign case study. The film remains the complete form.
fieldTitle: AN EARLIER INSTRUMENT: TIME SHAPED INSIDE AN IMAGE.
modes: Read the space, gesture and pressure already present.
Build a musical condition rather than an explanation.
Let sound disappear back into the complete work.
enables: Let music remain part of the film rather than sit above it.
destinationCopy: Return to the practice to open another instrument, case or selected work.

title: TRUE LOVERS
description: True Lovers — album by Lonely Band, 2017.
subtitle: Album · Lonely Band.
question: HOW DOES A RECORD BECOME A WORLD SOMEONE CAN RETURN TO?
bodyOne: True Lovers sits inside the musical work from which the later instruments grew: writing, recording and performance as forms of world construction.
bodyTwo: The archive is evidence of continuity. Before the protocol was named, the same concern was already present — create a durable interior with its own rules.
fieldTitle: SONG AS A ROOM. A RECORD AS ITS ADDRESS.
modes: Find the emotional rule that holds the material together.
Give the rule a surface, duration and atmosphere.
Open the same world again in another room.
enablesTitle: A COHERENT PLACE ACROSS MANY SONGS.
enables: Carry one atmosphere through a complete record.
Move between private writing and public performance.
Make repetition feel like return rather than duplication.
destinationCopy: Return to the practice to open another instrument, case or selected work.
